<script>
(function(){
const MODEL = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('model-json').textContent);
const ISSUES = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('issues-json').textContent);
const GRID = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('grid-json').textContent);
const TL = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('timeline-json').textContent || 'null');
const PUB = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('public-json').textContent || 'null') || {};  // 社外配布版の設定（popup/hideDates/hideTasks） // 時系列表示 (null なら無効)
const S = 0.001; // mm -> m
const INF = 1e9;
// 時系列表示: 頂点属性 aLife=(出現, 撤去, 建方日のみ) とシェーダの uTime 比較で部材を出し入れ (ドローコールを増やさない)
const TU = {uTime:{value:0}, uMode:{value:0}, uErect:{value:0}};
function addLife(mat){
  mat.onBeforeCompile = (sh)=>{
    Object.assign(sh.uniforms, TU);
    sh.vertexShader = 'attribute vec3 aLife;\nuniform float uTime;\nuniform float uMode;\nuniform float uErect;\n' + sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <project_vertex>',
      '#include <project_vertex>\n  if(uMode>0.5){ bool vis = aLife.z>0.5 ? (uErect>0.5 && uTime>=aLife.x) : (uTime>=aLife.x && uTime<aLife.y); if(!vis) gl_Position=vec4(2.0,2.0,2.0,1.0); }');
  };
  mat.customProgramCacheKey = ()=>'timeline';
  return mat;
}
const canvas = document.getElementById('view');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias:true, preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.localClippingEnabled = true;
const scene = new THREE.Scene(); scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf4f6f8);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 2000); camera.up.set(0,0,1);
const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, canvas); controls.enableDamping = true; controls.dampingFactor = 0.12;
controls.mouseButtons = {LEFT: THREE.MOUSE.ROTATE, MIDDLE: THREE.MOUSE.DOLLY, RIGHT: THREE.MOUSE.PAN};
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8899aa, 0.9));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8); sun.position.set(30, -40, 60); scene.add(sun);
const sun2 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.35); sun2.position.set(-30, 30, 20); scene.add(sun2);

// ---- 躯体 (mm -> m, Z-up) ----
const clipPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1), 40); // z <= const
const bldgMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x8a9099, side:THREE.DoubleSide, transparent:true, opacity:1, clippingPlanes:[clipPlane]});
const typeColor = {IfcColumn:0x7d8590, IfcBeam:0x8f98a3, IfcPlate:0x9aa3ad, IfcMember:0x8f98a3};
const elemIndex = []; // {name, storey, type, start, count}
(function buildBuilding(){
  let nv=0, nf=0; for(const e of MODEL.elements){nv+=e.v.length/3; nf+=e.f.length;}
  const pos = new Float32Array(nv*3), col = new Float32Array(nv*3); const idx = new Uint32Array(nf);
  const life = new Float32Array(nv*3), dcol = new Float32Array(nv*3);
  let vo=0, fo=0;
  const dc = new THREE.Color();
  for(const e of MODEL.elements){
    const c = new THREE.Color(typeColor[e.type]||0x8a9099);
    dc.set(TL && e.k ? TL.dayColors[e.k-1] : '#9aa3ad');
    const base = vo/3;
    for(let i=0;i<e.v.length;i+=3){pos[vo]=e.v[i]*S; pos[vo+1]=e.v[i+1]*S; pos[vo+2]=e.v[i+2]*S; col[vo]=c.r; col[vo+1]=c.g; col[vo+2]=c.b;
      life[vo]=(e.t??0); life[vo+1]=INF; life[vo+2]=0; dcol[vo]=dc.r; dcol[vo+1]=dc.g; dcol[vo+2]=dc.b; vo+=3;}
    elemIndex.push({name:e.name, storey:e.storey, type:e.type, start:fo, count:e.f.length});
    for(let i=0;i<e.f.length;i++){idx[fo++]=e.f[i]+base;}
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3)); g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col,3));
  g.setAttribute('aLife', new THREE.BufferAttribute(life,3));
  g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(idx,1)); g.computeVertexNormals();
  bldgMat.vertexColors = true;
  addLife(bldgMat);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(g, bldgMat); mesh.name='building'; scene.add(mesh);
  mesh.userData.colIFC = col.slice(); mesh.userData.colDay = dcol;   // 時系列表示では建方日の色
  window.__bldg = mesh;
})();
// 地盤・道路の目安
(function ground(){
  const site = GRID.site, road = GRID.road;
  const g1 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry((site.x1-site.x0)*S,(site.y1-site.y0)*S), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xe3e6ea}));
  g1.position.set((site.x0+site.x1)/2*S,(site.y0+site.y1)/2*S,-0.03); scene.add(g1);
  const g2 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(60,(road.y1-road.y0)*S), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xd0d4d9}));
  g2.position.set(7.4,(road.y0+road.y1)/2*S,-0.04); scene.add(g2);
  const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(80, 80, 0xcfd4da, 0xe4e7eb); grid.rotation.x = Math.PI/2; grid.position.set(7.4,0,-0.05); scene.add(grid);
})();

// ---- 安全対策オブジェクト ----
const labelLayer = document.getElementById('labels');
const labels = []; // {el, pos:Vector3, issue, tag}
const issueGroups = {}; // id -> {group, tags:{tag:Group}, mats:[]}
function matFor(color, opacity){
  return addLife(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(color), transparent:true, opacity:opacity, side:THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: opacity>=0.99}));
}
// 同一 (タグ, 色, 不透明度) の部材を1メッシュに統合（数万部材でも軽く描ける）。faceRanges でクリック時の名称を引く。
const _tmpM = new THREE.Matrix4(), _tmpQ = new THREE.Quaternion(), _tmpP = new THREE.Vector3(), _tmpS = new THREE.Vector3(1,1,1), _tmpE = new THREE.Euler();
let curLife = [0, INF, 0];   // addPrimitive 中の部材の (出現, 撤去, 建方日のみ)
function pushGeom(bucket, geom, matrix, name){
  const g = geom.index ? geom.toNonIndexed() : geom; g.applyMatrix4(matrix);
  const pos = g.attributes.position.array, nor = g.attributes.normal.array;
  bucket.ranges.push({start: bucket.count/3, count: pos.length/3, name});
  bucket.pos.push(pos); bucket.nor.push(nor); bucket.count += pos.length;
  const lf = new Float32Array(pos.length); for(let i=0;i<lf.length;i+=3){ lf[i]=curLife[0]; lf[i+1]=curLife[1]; lf[i+2]=curLife[2]; }
  bucket.life.push(lf);
  if(g!==geom) geom.dispose();
}
function bucketFor(ig, tag, color, opacity){
  if(!ig.tags[tag]){ig.tags[tag]=new THREE.Group(); ig.tags[tag].name=tag; ig.group.add(ig.tags[tag]);}
  const key = tag+'|'+color+'|'+opacity;
  if(!ig.buckets[key]) ig.buckets[key] = {tag, color, opacity, pos:[], nor:[], life:[], count:0, ranges:[]};
  return ig.buckets[key];
}
function addPrimitive(ig, o, issue){
  const tag = o.tag||'';
  if(o.kind==='label'){
    if(!ig.tags[tag]){ig.tags[tag]=new THREE.Group(); ig.tags[tag].name=tag; ig.group.add(ig.tags[tag]);}
    const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='lbl'; el.textContent=o.text; el.style.borderColor=o.color||'#333'; el.style.color='#1f2933';
    labelLayer.appendChild(el); labels.push({el, pos:new THREE.Vector3(...o.center.map(v=>v*S)), issue:issue.id, tag, visible:true, tl:o.tl||[0,INF,0]});
    return;
  }
  curLife = o.tl || [0, INF, 0];
  const b = bucketFor(ig, tag, o.color, o.opacity ?? 1);
  if(o.kind==='box'){
    _tmpE.set(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(o.rot[0]),THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(o.rot[1]),THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(o.rot[2]),'ZYX'); _tmpQ.setFromEuler(_tmpE);
    _tmpP.set(o.center[0]*S,o.center[1]*S,o.center[2]*S); _tmpM.compose(_tmpP,_tmpQ,_tmpS);
    pushGeom(b, new THREE.BoxGeometry(o.size[0]*S,o.size[1]*S,o.size[2]*S), _tmpM, o.name);
  }else if(o.kind==='cyl'){
    _tmpE.set(o.axis==='z'?Math.PI/2:0, 0, o.axis==='x'?-Math.PI/2:0, 'XYZ'); _tmpQ.setFromEuler(_tmpE);
    _tmpP.set(o.center[0]*S,o.center[1]*S,o.center[2]*S); _tmpM.compose(_tmpP,_tmpQ,_tmpS);
    const seg = o.radius*S > 0.1 ? 18 : 10;
    pushGeom(b, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(o.radius*S,o.radius*S,o.length*S,seg), _tmpM, o.name);
  }else if(o.kind==='sphere'){
    _tmpP.set(o.center[0]*S,o.center[1]*S,o.center[2]*S); _tmpM.compose(_tmpP,_tmpQ.identity(),_tmpS);
    pushGeom(b, new THREE.SphereGeometry(o.radius*S,14,10), _tmpM, o.name);
  }else if(o.kind==='line'){
    const r = (o.width||30)/2*S;
    for(let i=0;i<o.points.length-1;i++){
      const a=new THREE.Vector3(...o.points[i].map(v=>v*S)), bb=new THREE.Vector3(...o.points[i+1].map(v=>v*S));
      const L=a.distanceTo(bb); if(L<1e-6) continue;
      _tmpQ.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), bb.clone().sub(a).normalize()); _tmpP.copy(a).lerp(bb,0.5); _tmpM.compose(_tmpP,_tmpQ,_tmpS);
      pushGeom(b, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,L,6), _tmpM, o.name);
    }
  }
}
function finalizeBuckets(ig, issue){
  for(const key in ig.buckets){
    const b = ig.buckets[key]; if(!b.count) continue;
    const pos = new Float32Array(b.count), nor = new Float32Array(b.count), lf = new Float32Array(b.count); let o=0;
    for(let i=0;i<b.pos.length;i++){ pos.set(b.pos[i],o); nor.set(b.nor[i],o); lf.set(b.life[i],o); o+=b.pos[i].length; }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3)); g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor,3));
    g.setAttribute('aLife', new THREE.BufferAttribute(lf,3));
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(g, matFor(b.color, b.opacity)); mesh.userData={issue:issue.id, ranges:b.ranges, baseOpacity:b.opacity};
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    ig.tags[b.tag].add(mesh); ig.mats.push(mesh.material); b.pos=null; b.nor=null; b.life=null;
  }
}
for(const issue of ISSUES){
  const ig = {group:new THREE.Group(), tags:{}, mats:[], buckets:{}, issue};
  ig.group.name = issue.id; issueGroups[issue.id]=ig; scene.add(ig.group);
  for(const o of issue.objects) addPrimitive(ig, o, issue);
  finalizeBuckets(ig, issue);
  const bb = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(ig.group); ig.bbox = bb;
}

// ---- UI ----
let active = null; const showAll = document.getElementById('chkAll');
const issuesEl = document.getElementById('issues');
for(const issue of ISSUES){
  const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='card'+(issue.status==='処置不要'?' na':''); card.dataset.id=issue.id;
  const st = issue.status||''; const stCls = st.includes('不要')?'na':(st.includes('済')?'done':'');
  card.innerHTML = `<div class="src">指導書 ${issue.source}</div><div class="ttl">${issue.title}</div><div class="sum">${issue.summary}</div>
    <div class="meta"><span class="chip ${stCls}">${st}</span>${PUB.hideTasks ? '' : `<span class="chip">担当:${issue.assignee}</span>`}<span class="chip">3D要素 ${issue.objects.filter(o=>o.kind!=='label').length}</span></div>`;
  card.addEventListener('click', ()=>selectIssue(issue.id, true));
  issuesEl.appendChild(card);
}
function applyVisibility(){
  for(const id in issueGroups){
    const ig = issueGroups[id]; const on = (active===null) || showAll.checked || id===active;
    ig.group.visible = on;
    const dim = (active!==null && id!==active && showAll.checked);
    ig.group.traverse(obj=>{ if(obj.isMesh){ obj.material.opacity = dim ? Math.min(obj.material.opacity, 0.18) : (obj.userData.baseOpacity ?? obj.material.opacity); }});
  }
  for(const l of labels){ l.visible = ((active===null)||l.issue===active) && document.getElementById('chkLabels').checked && issueGroups[l.issue].group.visible && (issueGroups[l.issue].tags[l.tag]?.visible ?? true); }
}
// 元の不透明度を記憶
for(const id in issueGroups) issueGroups[id].group.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh) o.userData.baseOpacity=o.material.opacity; });
function selectIssue(id, fly){
  active = id; document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('active', c.dataset.id===id));
  const issue = ISSUES.find(i=>i.id===id); const ig = issueGroups[id];
  const tagsHtml = issue.tags.filter(t=>t).length ? `<div id="tags">${issue.tags.filter(t=>t).map(t=>`<label><input type="checkbox" data-tag="${t}" checked>${t}</label>`).join('')}</div>` : '';
  document.getElementById('detail').innerHTML = `<h2>${issue.source}　${issue.title}</h2>${tagsHtml}<div class="html">${issue.html}</div>`;
  document.querySelectorAll('#tags input').forEach(cb=>cb.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ ig.tags[cb.dataset.tag].visible = cb.checked; applyVisibility(); }));
  for(const t in ig.tags) ig.tags[t].visible = true;
  applyVisibility();
  if(fly) flyToIssue(issue);
}
function flyToIssue(issue){
  const ig = issueGroups[issue.id];
  if(issue.camera){ setCam(issue.camera.pos.map(v=>v*S), issue.camera.target.map(v=>v*S)); return; }
  const bb = ig.bbox; if(bb.isEmpty()) return;
  const c = bb.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()); const size = bb.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length();
  const d = Math.max(size*0.9, 8);
  setCam([c.x+d*0.7, c.y-d*0.8, c.z+d*0.55], [c.x,c.y,c.z]);
}
function setCam(p, t){ camera.position.set(p[0],p[1],p[2]); controls.target.set(t[0],t[1],t[2]); controls.update(); }
const bbAll = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(window.__bldg); const cAll = bbAll.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
const VIEWS = {
  iso: ()=>setCam([cAll.x+45, cAll.y-48, 42],[cAll.x,cAll.y,cAll.z*0.9]),
  top: ()=>setCam([cAll.x+0.01, cAll.y-0.01, 120],[cAll.x,cAll.y,0]),
  south: ()=>setCam([cAll.x, cAll.y-90, cAll.z],[cAll.x,cAll.y,cAll.z]),
  east: ()=>setCam([cAll.x+90, cAll.y, cAll.z],[cAll.x,cAll.y,cAll.z]),
};
document.querySelectorAll('#toolbar button[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>VIEWS[b.dataset.view]()));
document.getElementById('btnFit').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ if(active) flyToIssue(ISSUES.find(i=>i.id===active)); });
showAll.addEventListener('change', applyVisibility);
document.getElementById('chkLabels').addEventListener('change', applyVisibility);
document.getElementById('rngOpacity').addEventListener('input', e=>{ bldgMat.opacity=parseFloat(e.target.value); bldgMat.depthWrite = bldgMat.opacity>0.99; });
document.getElementById('rngZ').addEventListener('input', e=>{ const z=parseFloat(e.target.value); clipPlane.constant = z;
  const st = [...GRID.storeys].reverse().find(s=>s.z*S<=z+0.01); document.getElementById('zval').textContent = z>=40?'全階':(`GL+${z.toFixed(1)}m`+(st?`(${st.name}以下)`:'')); });

[] : ["作業主任者・玉掛け技能講習修了者の氏名と修了証番号を計画書へ記入する。", "昇降用タラップの取付柱（A通り／C通りのどちらか）を建方計画図の昇降設備設置箇所と照合して確定する。", "前面道路での柱の荷降ろし・建て起こし、梁の車両脇仮置きについて、道路使用許可の範囲・時間帯と交通誘導員配置をゼネコン・所轄警察署と協議する。", "足場業者へ「鉄骨建方期間中は最上段900mmを組まない」前提での壁つなぎ計算書（突出し2.80m）を依頼する。", "使用する仮設機材（NKハンガー NKH0714の台数、ハイステップ、ブラケット NKB500、台付ワイヤー・レバーブロック等）の製品名とカタログを計画書に添付する。", "ゼネコン建方計画図の通り①柱位置がREAL4製作モデルと約850mm異なるため、図面の版を確認する。", "外部足場は足場計画図（階高3,300の旧設計）の段ピッチ1,800をREAL4の階高3,200・RSL 35,950に合わせて20段に調整している。足場業者の実割付図と照合する。", "屋外避難階段の段数・蹴上（意匠図注記206.3は階高3,300時）を階高3,200で意匠設計者に再確認し、製作範囲（R階まで含むか）を決める。"];

(function legend(){

  document.getElementById('legend').innerHTML = '<b>凡例</b>' + items.map(i=>`<div class="row"><span class="sw" style="background:${i[0]}"></span>${i[1]}</div>`).join('');

// ---- ピッキング ----
const ray = new THREE.Raycaster(); const mouse = new THREE.Vector2(); let downAt=null;
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{downAt=[e.clientX,e.clientY];});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', e=>{
  if(!downAt || Math.hypot(e.clientX-downAt[0], e.clientY-downAt[1])>4) return;
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1, -((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
  const objs = []; for(const id in issueGroups){ if(issueGroups[id].group.visible) objs.push(issueGroups[id].group); }
  let hits = ray.intersectObjects(objs, true).filter(h=>h.object.visible && h.object.parent.visible);
  let text = null;
  if(hits.length){ const h=hits[0]; const u=h.object.userData; const vi=h.faceIndex*3; const rg=(u.ranges||[]).find(x=>vi>=x.start && vi<x.start+x.count); text=`${u.issue}　${rg?rg.name:''}`; }
  else{
    const hb = ray.intersectObject(window.__bldg, false);
    if(hb.length){ const fi = hb[0].faceIndex*3; const el = elemIndex.find(x=>fi>=x.start && fi<x.start+x.count); if(el) text=`${el.name}（${el.storey}）`; }
  }
  showPick(text, e.clientX-r.left, e.clientY-r.top);
});
let pickEl=null;
function showPick(text,x,y){ if(pickEl){pickEl.remove(); pickEl=null;} if(!text) return; pickEl=document.createElement('div'); pickEl.className='lbl'; pickEl.style.left=x+'px'; pickEl.style.top=(y-8)+'px'; pickEl.style.background='#fff8e1'; pickEl.textContent=text; labelLayer.appendChild(pickEl); }

// ---- 時系列表示 (現場工程表どおりに 1日目から) ----
const timeOK = (tl)=> tl[2]>0.5 ? (TU.uErect.value>0.5 && TU.uTime.value>=tl[0]) : (TU.uTime.value>=tl[0] && TU.uTime.value<tl[1]);
const TM = {on:false, playing:false, t:0, last:0};
const WORK_COLOR = {'本締':'#94a3b8','デッキ':'#64748b','タッチアップ':'#d97706','柱溶接':'#ea580c','スタッド':'#0d9488'};
function dayColorOf(d){ if(d.erect) return TL.dayColors[d.erect.k-1]; const w=(d.work||[]).join('/'); for(const k in WORK_COLOR) if(w.includes(k)) return WORK_COLOR[k]; return '#94a3b8'; }
let cumW = [];
if(TL){
  const ps = TL.products.filter(p=>p.t!=null).sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t); let acc=0; cumW = ps.map(p=>[p.t, acc+=p.w]);
  const box = document.getElementById('tDays');
  TL.days.forEach((d,i)=>{ const el=document.createElement('div'); el.textContent=d.n; el.style.background=dayColorOf(d);
    if(d.erect) el.classList.add('erect'); if(d.scaffold) el.classList.add('scaf');
    el.title=`${d.n}日目 ${PUB.hideDates ? '' : `${d.date}(${d.dow}) `}${d.erect?('建方 '+d.erect.floors+'（'+d.erect.place+'）'):(d.work||[]).join('・')}${d.scaffold?'・外部足場':''}`;
    el.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ TM.playing=false; seekTime(d.t0+1); }); box.appendChild(el); });
  const cats = [['#16a34a','緑の線：外部足場を上げる日'], ['#94a3b8','本締'], ['#64748b','デッキ'], ['#ea580c','柱溶接・タッチアップ'], ['#0d9488','スタッド']];
  document.getElementById('tCats').innerHTML = cats.map(c=>`<span><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:${c[0]};border-radius:2px;margin-right:3px"></span>${c[1]}</span>`).join('')
    + (PUB.hideDates ? '' : `<span>　工程：${TL.schedule}　建方順番：${TL.erectionSource}</span>`);
}else{ document.getElementById('btnTime').style.display='none'; }
function clockOf(t){ const DW=TL.dayWork; const day=Math.max(0,Math.floor(t/DW)); let min=8*60+(t-day*DW)/60; if(min>=12*60) min+=60; return `${Math.floor(min/60)}:${String(Math.floor(min%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`; }
function dayAt(t){ return TL.days[Math.min(TL.days.length-1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(t/TL.dayWork)))]; }
function cumAt(t){ let lo=0,hi=cumW.length-1,k=-1; while(lo<=hi){const m=(lo+hi)>>1; if(cumW[m][0]<=t){k=m;lo=m+1;}else hi=m-1;} return k>=0?cumW[k][1]:0; }
function seekTime(t){
  const end = TL.days[TL.days.length-1].t1;
  TM.t = Math.max(0, Math.min(end, t)); TU.uTime.value = TM.t;
  const d = dayAt(TM.t); TU.uErect.value = d.erect ? 1 : 0;
  document.getElementById('tSlider').value = String(Math.round(TM.t/end*1000));
  const w = (d.work||[]).join('・');
  document.getElementById('tInfo').textContent = `${d.n}日目 / ${TL.days.length}日　${PUB.hideDates ? '' : `${d.date}（${d.dow}）`}${clockOf(TM.t)}　` +
    (d.erect ? `建方 ${d.erect.floors}（25t ${d.erect.place}据え・10t車 ${d.erect.trucks}台）` : w) + (d.scaffold ? '・外部足場' : '');
  document.getElementById('tSub').textContent = `鉄骨 累計 ${cumAt(TM.t).toFixed(1)}t / ${TL.totalW.toFixed(1)}t　` +
    (w.includes('デッキ')?'デッキは下の階から敷込み　':'') + (w.includes('溶接')?'柱の現場溶接（前日に溶接足場を設置）　':'') +
    (d.scaffold?'建方が済んだ高さまで外部足場を上げる　':'') + (d.erect?'建方日のみ：作業主任者・玉掛け者・路上仮置き':'');
  document.querySelectorAll('#tDays div').forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('cur', i===d.n-1 || TL.days[i]===d));
}
function setTimeMode(on){
  TM.on = on; TU.uMode.value = on?1:0; document.body.classList.toggle('timemode', on);
  document.getElementById('btnTime').classList.toggle('on', on);
  document.getElementById('timebar').hidden = !on;
  const g = window.__bldg.geometry.attributes.color; g.array.set(on ? window.__bldg.userData.colDay : window.__bldg.userData.colIFC); g.needsUpdate = true;
  const lb = document.getElementById('chkLabels');
  if(on){ active=null; document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active')); showAll.checked=true; TM.labelsWas=lb.checked; lb.checked=false; applyVisibility(); seekTime(TM.t); legendTime(); }
  else { TM.playing=false; if(TM.labelsWas!==undefined) lb.checked=TM.labelsWas; legendNormal(); applyVisibility(); }
  document.getElementById('tPlay').textContent = '▶ 再生'; document.getElementById('tPlay').classList.remove('playing');
}
document.getElementById('btnTime').addEventListener('click', ()=>setTimeMode(!TM.on));
document.getElementById('tPlay').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ const end=TL.days[TL.days.length-1].t1; if(TM.t>=end) seekTime(0); TM.playing=!TM.playing; TM.last=0; document.getElementById('tPlay').textContent = TM.playing?'❚❚ 一時停止':'▶ 再生'; document.getElementById('tPlay').classList.toggle('playing', TM.playing); });
document.getElementById('tSlider').addEventListener('input', e=>{ TM.playing=false; document.getElementById('tPlay').textContent='▶ 再生'; document.getElementById('tPlay').classList.remove('playing'); seekTime(e.target.value/1000*TL.days[TL.days.length-1].t1); });
document.getElementById('tPrev').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ TM.playing=false; const d=dayAt(TM.t); seekTime(TL.days[Math.max(0,TL.days.indexOf(d)-1)].t0+1); });
document.getElementById('tNext').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ TM.playing=false; const d=dayAt(TM.t); seekTime(TL.days[Math.min(TL.days.length-1,TL.days.indexOf(d)+1)].t0+1); });
// 再生: 建方日は 1日 ≒ 8秒、その他の日は ≒ 2秒 (標準)
function advance(now){
  if(!TM.on || !TM.playing){ TM.last=now; return; }
  const dt = TM.last ? Math.min(0.1,(now-TM.last)/1000) : 0; TM.last=now;
  const d = dayAt(TM.t), spd = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tSpeed').value);
  const secPerDay = (d.erect ? 8 : 2) / spd;
  const end = TL.days[TL.days.length-1].t1;
  seekTime(TM.t + dt * TL.dayWork / secPerDay);
  if(TM.t>=end){ TM.playing=false; document.getElementById('tPlay').textContent='▶ 再生'; document.getElementById('tPlay').classList.remove('playing'); }
}
let legendHtmlNormal = null;
function legendNormal(){ if(legendHtmlNormal!==null) document.getElementById('legend').innerHTML = legendHtmlNormal; }
function legendTime(){
  const el = document.getElementById('legend'); if(legendHtmlNormal===null) legendHtmlNormal = el.innerHTML;
  const ed = TL.days.filter(d=>d.erect);
  el.innerHTML = '<b>建方日（工程表の色）</b>' + ed.map(d=>`<div class="row"><span class="sw" style="background:${TL.dayColors[d.erect.k-1]}"></span>${d.n}日目　${d.erect.floors}　${d.erect.place}</div>`).join('')
    + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px;color:#6b7280">足場・安全仮設は各対策の色</div>';
}

// ---- ループ ----
function resize(){ const w=canvas.clientWidth, h=canvas.clientHeight; if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){ renderer.setSize(w,h,false); camera.aspect=w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); } }
const tmp = new THREE.Vector3();
function updateLabels(){
  const w=canvas.clientWidth, h=canvas.clientHeight;
  for(const l of labels){
    if(!l.visible || (TM.on && !timeOK(l.tl))){ l.el.style.display='none'; continue; }
    tmp.copy(l.pos).project(camera);
    if(tmp.z>1 || tmp.x<-1.1||tmp.x>1.1||tmp.y<-1.1||tmp.y>1.1){ l.el.style.display='none'; continue; }
    l.el.style.display='block'; l.el.style.left=((tmp.x+1)/2*w)+'px'; l.el.style.top=((1-tmp.y)/2*h)+'px';
  }
}
function loop(now){ resize(); advance(now||0); controls.update(); renderer.render(scene, camera); updateLabels(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
VIEWS.iso(); applyVisibility(); document.getElementById('loading').remove(); loop();
// ---- 時系列再生への導線（社外配布版: 起動時ポップアップ＋右下の再生ボタン＋ツールバー強調） ----
if(TL && PUB.popup){
  const startPlay = ()=>{ document.getElementById('tlPop').hidden = true; if(!TM.on) setTimeMode(true); seekTime(0); TM.playing = true; TM.last = 0;
    const b = document.getElementById('tPlay'); b.textContent='❚❚ 一時停止'; b.classList.add('playing'); };
  document.getElementById('btnTime').classList.add('hot');
  document.getElementById('tlFab').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('tlFab').addEventListener('click', startPlay);
  document.getElementById('tlGo').addEventListener('click', startPlay);
  document.getElementById('tlSkip').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('tlPop').hidden = true; });
  document.getElementById('tlPop').hidden = false;
}
window.__viewer = {selectIssue, VIEWS, scene, camera, controls, renderer, ISSUES, setTimeMode, seekTime, TL, labels, applyVisibility, issueGroups};
})();
</script>


</body></html>
/**
 * OBJ形式のテキストを、この3Dビューワー用のJSON形式に変換する関数
 * @param {string} objText OBJファイルの中身
 * @param {string} type 部材の種類 (IfcColumn, IfcBeamなど)
 */
function convertObjToModelJson(objText, type = "IfcColumn") {
    const lines = objText.split('\n');
    const vertices = [];
    const faces = [];
    
    for (let line of lines) {
        const parts = line.trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (parts[0] === 'v') {
            vertices.push(parts.slice(1).map(Number));
        } else if (parts[0] === 'f') {
            // OBJのインデックスは1から始まるため-1する
            faces.push(parts.slice(1).map(p => parseInt(p.split('/')[0]) - 1));
        }
    }

    // 面のインデックスを元に、頂点座標をフラットな配列に変換
    const vData = [];
    for (let face of faces) {
        for (let index of face) {
            vData.push(...vertices[index]);
        }
    }

    return JSON.stringify({
        id: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000),
        type: type,
        v: vData.map(v => Math.round(v)) // 整数化して軽量化
    });
}
